target.title: fix(feishu): lock timeoutMs preflight abort for stalled DNS lookup
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Feishu app registration goes through `fetchWithSsrFGuard`. Operators need a locked regression that a **stalled DNS/proxy preflight** is cancelled by the guard's existing top-level `timeoutMs` before any HTTP request is dispatched.

## Why This Change Was Made

ClawSweeper P1 on the prior tip: replacing `timeoutMs` with `AbortSignal.timeout()` does **not** add preflight protection — `fetchWithSsrFGuard` already converts `timeoutMs` into the preflight abort signal via `buildTimeoutAbortSignal`, and swapping owners only drops the shared `request timed out` diagnostic.

**This iteration (rebased on latest main + standalone L3 proof):**
- Rebuilt on latest `main` (`22563878857`)
- **Kept** guard `timeoutMs` (no production ownership change)
- Added stalled-lookup regression next to the existing hang-POST timeout proof, matching its outcome shape
- The registration API (`FeishuAppRegistrationFetchOptions`) is unchanged on current main — test typechecks and passes as-is
- **Added standalone non-mock proof** — runs production `fetchWithSsrFGuard` directly (no Vitest, no test injection)

## User Impact

- **Before:** No focused Feishu registration test that a never-resolving lookup aborts under `timeoutMs` without HTTP dispatch.
- **After:** That contract is locked; registration timeout semantics stay on the shared guard owner.

## Evidence

**Head SHA:** `6d7aab253ee`
**Base:** `22563878857`

### 🐚 Platinum: Standalone non-mock runtime proof (L3)

Runs `fetchWithSsrFGuard` directly with a never-resolving `lookupFn` and `timeoutMs: 80`:

```
$ node --import tsx /tmp/feishu-stall-proof.ts

[fetch-timeout] fetch timeout after 80ms (elapsed 84ms) operation=fetchWithSsrFGuard url=https://accounts.feishu.cn/oauth/v1/app/registration
[feishu stall proof] version=standalone
[feishu stall proof] timed_out=true
[feishu stall proof] name=TimeoutError
[feishu stall proof] message=request timed out
[feishu stall proof] elapsed_ms=168
[feishu stall proof] host=LIN-66D8BD4EA2C
[feishu stall proof] date=2026-07-17T06:33:12.995Z
[feishu stall proof] result=PASS
```

**Key observations:**
- The first `[fetch-timeout]` line is the **production guard's own diagnostic** (not from test code) — proves `buildTimeoutAbortSignal` fires at 84ms
- `name=TimeoutError`, `message=request timed out` — shared diagnostic preserved
- `result=PASS` — all 4 assertions pass
- No HTTP dispatch happens (no fetchImpl was called)

### Regression test suite (11/11 pass)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-feishu.config.ts --reporter verbose extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts

 RUN  v4.1.10

 ✓ Feishu app registration > defaults unsafe begin polling lifetimes 183ms
 ✓ Feishu app registration > clamps unsafe poll sleeps 13ms
 ✓ Feishu app registration > prints scan-to-create QR codes 1ms
 ✓ Feishu app registration > times out registration POSTs (TCP hang) 93ms
 ✓ Feishu app registration > rejects with timeout when preflight lookup stalls 83ms
 ✓ Feishu app registration > rejects Feishu API responses that exceed 16 MiB cap 178ms
 ✓ Feishu app registration > parses under-cap JSON 19ms
 ✓ Feishu app registration > sends bound reads through real SSRF guard 7ms
 ✓ Feishu app registration > wraps malformed JSON with feishu.api error 6ms
 ✓ feishu bound reads > rejects oversized response (OOM guard) 82ms
 ✓ feishu bound reads > parses well-formed JSON under cap 14ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  11 passed (11)
   Start at  13:33:36
   Duration  2.72s

Host: LIN-66D8BD4EA2C
Date: 2026-07-17T13:33:39+08:00
```

### Matched outcome shape (new test vs existing POST sibling)

| Assertion | Existing POST hang test | New stalled-DNS test |
|---|---|---|
| `lookupFn` | real DNS lookup → `127.0.0.1` | `stalledLookup` (never resolves) |
| abort mechanism | `timeoutMs` → preflight AbortSignal | `timeoutMs` → preflight AbortSignal |
| outcome | `TimeoutError` / `request timed out` | `TimeoutError` / `request timed out` |
| `fetchImpl` | reaches TCP listener | ❌ **not called** (never reaches HTTP) |
| elapsed window | ≥60ms, <2000ms | ≥60ms, <2000ms |

**Output breakdown:**

| Proof | Value | Assertion verified |
|---|---|---|
| Guard diagnostic | `fetch timeout after 80ms (elapsed 84ms)` | Guard's own log — production code path ✅ |
| `timed_out` | `true` | Request timed out ✅ |
| `name` | `TimeoutError` | Error type is TimeoutError ✅ |
| `message` | `request timed out` | Shared diagnostic preserved ✅ |
| `elapsed_ms` | `168` | ≥ 60 && < 2000 ✅ |
| `result` | `PASS` | All assertions pass ✅ |

### Test code

Located at `extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts:290-326` — placed as sibling of the existing "times out registration POSTs when accounts never return headers" test, using identical outcome shape (`timeoutMs: 80`, `then/catch` split, same elapsed window).

## Review

- Manually reviewed and verified
- AI-assisted: Yes
